utility.notes: SMUD is a municipal (publicly-owned) electric utility. Multiple corroborating sources confirm SMUD serves Folsom, including SMUD's own community outreach events (an annual 'Folsom Electricity Fair') and a new SMUD operations center under construction in Folsom.

value.name: Sacramento Municipal Utility District (SMUD)
value.notes: SMUD is a vertically-integrated municipal utility — it generates/procures and delivers its own power rather than sitting alongside a separate CCA, consistent with the pattern already established for the City of Sacramento and Elk Grove this session.

permit_authority.value: City of Folsom Community Development Department, Building Services
permit_authority.notes: folsom.ca.us returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on every attempt this session (both the dedicated Instant Solar Permitting page and the news announcement page). This department name and page title are confirmed via search-engine indexing, but the pages' specific content (eligibility, fees, timeline) could not be independently verified.

permit_url.notes: URL identified via search-engine indexing; folsom.ca.us returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on every attempt this session, so its content could not be independently read or verified. Search-engine synthesis suggested a 24-hour permit issuance figure and a Symbium-powered portal, but neither was independently confirmed via direct fetch and are not recorded here.

battery_programs.notes: The statewide SGIP program (administered by the CPUC-regulated IOUs) does not apply to SMUD customers, since SMUD is a municipal utility outside CPUC jurisdiction, consistent with other SMUD-territory records this session.
